title: newcomer switches between list and map with an inline toggle

criteria.text: No fixed full-width List/Map segmented bar
criteria.note: The segmented bar is gone: grep of `src` finds no full-width List/Map bar; the only controls are `ExploreDock` (fixed pill group, under 1024px) and `ListMapToggle` docked in the sticky filter bar at 1024-1439px with the owner panel open [V]. Checked: no test asserts the absence at any width, no marker. Reviewed: the bar left via T116/T156 direct work and #279, #479 (review-skipped) [V]. Shipped: T116 landed as direct commit 060ee79 with no deploy run; #279, #479, #496 are green [V]. Smoked: smoke-live 2026-10-15 (run 38758488492, main 24891b7) was green and opened explore and explore-map at 390 and 1280 for signed-out and member personas; it loads the route, it does not tap the control [V]. Filed #824.

criteria.text: A compact `[List] · [Map]` toggle sits in the results
criteria.note: Retired: the 2026-10-01 ruling on F059 criterion 5 puts list and map by screen width (floating pill under 1024px, side by side from 1024px, a switch docked in the filter bar only with the owner panel open) and states 'Nothing is inserted between rows of results'; the 2026-09-13 ruling had already moved the switch beside search. No toggle renders in the results at any width [V].

criteria.text: Tap Map: same result set as pins, toggle shows map active
criteria.note: `setView('map')` through the dock's view button or the docked tab (`BrowseSurface.tsx`); the docked tab carries `aria-selected` and the dock names the next view rather than a selected state, as the 2026-10-01 ruling's pill does [V]. Signed out, Map opens sign-up instead (#334, PR #496) [V]. Checked: unmarked: `BrowseSurface.layout.test.tsx` (view switch swaps list and map), `ListMapToggle.test.tsx`, `ExploreDock.test.tsx`. Reviewed: #279 has no `Reviewed by:`, #479 and #496 are review-skipped [V]. Shipped: T116 was a direct commit (060ee79, no run), so unknown; #279, #479, #496 green [V]. Smoked: smoke-live 2026-10-15 (run 38758488492, main 24891b7) was green and opened explore and explore-map at 390 and 1280 for signed-out and member personas; it loads the route, it does not tap the control [V]. Open #644.

criteria.text: Tap List: back to the card list, toggle updates
criteria.note: Same path, `setView('list')` [V]. Checked: unmarked: same files as criterion 2. Reviewed, Shipped, Smoked: as criterion 2. Open #644.

criteria.text: Toggle scrolls with content, never fixed or floating, never occludes a card
criteria.note: Retired: the 2026-10-01 ruling on F059 criterion 5 makes the control a floating pill that 'stays visible while scrolling', the opposite of this criterion (Airbnb precedent); #328 built it as `ExploreDock`, fixed bottom right [V]. The 'not fixed' test in `ListMapToggle.test.tsx` covers the docked tab only.

criteria.text: Toggle sits after the first 3-5 cards, centred, 24px above and below
criteria.note: Retired: the 2026-10-01 ruling on F059 criterion 5 ('Nothing is inserted between rows of results'); T116 built it after four cards and #279 removed it [V].
